review_evidence: README presents Aegis as a Lean tool for verifying Cairo code via loaded Sierra programs, user specifications, and proofs.
Aegis/ defines the parser, semantics, command/specification machinery, and libfunc models; the reviewed source has over 400 declaration-shaped items.

Aegis/Tests/ contains concrete specifications and verification cases across integer, array, bitwise, syscall, storage-address, nullable and other libfunc families; treating the entire test tree as noise would remove useful semantic/specification examples.
summary: Retain Aegis implementation and test corpus because the tests contain executable formal specifications for Cairo/Sierra libfunc semantics and are part of the useful verification prior art.
